notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve. Early discovery — high urgency on UX. CTO quote: "We keep seeing spikes to ~2s which is killing user feel — can we get p95 < 800ms?". Primary workload: in-app chat assistant + document search fallback. Currently routing from eu-west-1; suspect cross-region routing to model instances in us-east is happening for some requests. Customer is cost sensitive — asks for guidance to reduce tokens and avoid replacing models. Short-term asks: region recommendation, timeout/HTTP client guidance, best-practices for prompt length and system messages, streaming examples.

Observed issues / quick notes:
- Large system prompt + verbose context for each request (historical convo + full KB snippet) — token bloat.
- UI does not use streaming; waits for full response, exacerbates perceived latency.
- p50 ~= 600-800ms, p95 spikes 1.8-2.4s during peaks.
- Customer uses Node SDK; default timeout in client layer set to 30s, but UI times out earlier at 3s causing retries.

SE recommendations shared:
- Move latency-sensitive traffic to nearest region (us-west-2 for majority of users) and test via curl from EU and NA to confirm routing.
- Use streaming responses for chat UI to improve time-to-first-byte even if final completion is longer.
- Trim system prompt: move static KB to embeddings+retrieval and only include top-2 passages. Use summarization to reduce context size.
- Set client-side read timeout to 10s, UI socket to allow streaming; avoid aggressive 3s frontend aborts to prevent retries.
- Try smaller model variant or a quantized vvariant for lower tokens/sec cost; Redwood Optimize suggestions link provided.

Action items agreed:
- Cerulean to run region A/B tests (eu-west vs us-west) and share perf logs by 2026-03-08.
- Redwood SE to provide a short sample repo for streaming (Node) and a prompt-trimming checklist.
- Follow-up call scheduled 2026-03-09 to review POC metrics.

Customer sentiment: frustrated but pragmatic. Wants realistic SLOs, not magic. Willing to iterate on prompts and region if clear metrics show improvement.
